cityQuote: Take Versailles, mix it with Antwerp, and you have Bordeaux.
cityQuoteAttribution: Victor Hugo, in his travel notes from Bordeaux, July 20, 1843
heroTitle: Bordeaux hero — Patrick Despoix (CC BY-SA 3.0, Wikimedia Commons)
wordsPreamble:
- Bordeaux speaks standard French, with a few words of its own from the old Gascon language of the southwest.
- Start every exchange with “bonjour.” Skipping it reads as rude, here as anywhere in France.
- English is common in hotels, wine bars, and tourist sites, less so in neighborhood shops.
- Locals call themselves Bordelais, and they will tell you the pastry is a chocolatine, not a pain au chocolat.
